title: Genus-Zero Pairings and Catalan Numbers
abstract: Formalizes the finite combinatorics behind the genus-zero term of the Wigner semicircle law: a pairing of Fin (2n), viewed as a fixed-point-free involution, has genus zero (total cycle count of the rotation product maximal) exactly when it is noncrossing, and these genus-zero pairings are counted by the Catalan number Cₙ. The Catalan recurrence is obtained from an explicit equivalence decomposing a noncrossing pairing by the partner of vertex 0 into independent inside and outside pairings.

informal.card_noncrossingPairing_eq_catalan: The number of noncrossing pairings on 2n points equals the Catalan number catalan n.
informal.Pairing.genus_zero_count: The number of genus-zero pairings of Fin (2n) equals the Catalan number catalan n.
informal.Pairing.genus_zero_iff_noncrossing: A pairing has genus zero if and only if it is noncrossing.
